question: What repeated effect does Kṛṣṇa have on the minds of the cowherd women?
premises: The cowherd women's minds are shining or stirred.
This enchantment occurs again and again.
inference: Kṛṣṇa repeatedly enchants the radiant minds of the cowherd women.
plain_english: Enchanting the shining minds of the cowherd women again and again.
